title: FG$^2$-GDN: Enhancing Long-Context Gated Delta Networks with Doubly Fine-Grained Control
abstract: arXiv:2604.19021v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Linear attention mechanisms have emerged as promising alternatives to softmax attention, offering linear-time complexity during inference. Recent advances such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) have demonstrated that the delta rule, an online gradient descent update, enables superior associative recall compared to simple additive updates. While KDA refined the coarse head-wise decay gate into channel-wise decay, the learning rate $\beta_t$ in the delta update remains a scalar, limiting the model's capacity for dimension-specific adaptation. We introduce FG$^2$-GDN, which replaces the scalar $\beta_t$ with a channel-wise vector analogous to the transition from SGD to per-coordinate adaptive optimizers such as AdaGrad and Adam. We further propose FG$^2$-GDN+, which decouples the scaling for keys and values, enabling independent control of erasure strength and write strength. Experiments on synthetic and real-world

translated_title: FG²-GDN：通过双重细粒度控制增强长上下文门控增量网络
translated_abstract: 线性注意力机制已成为softmax注意力的有前景的替代方案，在推理时具有线性时间复杂度。近期的研究进展，如Gated DeltaNet（GDN）和Kimi Delta Attention（KDA），已经证明增量规则（delta rule，一种在线梯度下降更新）相比简单的加性更新能够实现更优的联想记忆能力。虽然KDA将粗粒度的头级衰减门控细化为通道级衰减，但增量更新中的学习率 $\beta_t$ 仍然是一个标量，这限制了模型进行维度特定适应的能力。我们提出了FG²-GDN，它将标量 $\beta_t$ 替换为通道级向量，类似于从SGD到AdaGrad和Adam等逐坐标自适应优化器的转变。我们进一步提出FG²-GDN+，它解耦了键和值的缩放，实现了对擦除强度和写入强度的独立控制。在合成和真实世界的（实验中）……
tldr: 提出FG²-GDN，通过将增量规则中的标量学习率替换为通道级向量，并进一步解耦键值缩放以独立控制擦除强度与写入强度，实现对长上下文线性注意力的双重细粒度控制。
en_tdlr: FG²-GDN enhances long-context gated delta networks by replacing the scalar learning rate in the delta rule with channel-wise vectors, and FG²-GDN+ further decouples key-value scaling to enable independent control of erasure and write strengths, achieving doubly fine-grained control.
